We seek to acquire existing stream and royalty interests or finance projects that are in the production, development or exploration stage in exchange for stream or royalty interests.
We expect stream interests to continue representing a significant portion of our total revenue.

• Acquisition and Management of Royalty Interests — A royalty is a non-operating interest in a mining project that provides the right to revenue or metals produced from the project after deducting specified costs, if any.

As of September 30, 2026, we owned royalty interests on 64 production stage properties, 26 development stage properties and 253 exploration stage properties, of which we consider 82 to be evaluation stage projects.

On February 26, 2026, we closed the agreement with Bear Creek Mining Corporation (“Bear Creek”) to restructure equity, debt and other interests in Bear Creek and its assets in return for increased royalty exposure to Bear Creek ’ s Corani project and a new royalty interest over the Mercedes project, cash and shares in Highlander Silver Corp.

In consideration for the debt settlement, we received $6.2 million cash, an incremental 1.75% NSR royalty on the Corani project in Peru (bringing the Company ’ s total royalty interest to 2.75%), and a new 2.0% NSR royalty on the Mercedes project.
On April 14, 2026, after the technical approval of the environmental impact assessment and publication of a pre-feasibility study for the Warintza project, we advanced Solaris Resources, Inc.
On July 17, 2026, we completed the restructuring of our ownership in Artmin Madençilik (“Artmin”), the joint venture company that owns 100% of the Hod Maden Project (the “Project”).
Metal prices have fluctuated widely in recent years, and we expect this volatility to continue.
We believe that our current liquidity and capital resources will be adequate to cover anticipated operating needs for the next 12 months, and thereafter for the foreseeable future.

statements.t: We had $1.225 billion of debt outstanding immediately after closing and initially expected to repay it within two years.
Just under one year later, we fully repaid that balance while also funding our regular quarterly dividend, repurchasing shares, and meeting our investment commitments at the Warintza Project.

We remain on track to meet our full-year guidance for gold sales, expect to be at or exceed the top end of our guidance ranges for silver and copper, and we have raised our sales guidance for other metals."
Based on strong year-to-date sales, we are raising our full-year sales guidance for other metals and expect to be at or exceed the top end of our guidance ranges for silver and copper.
We continue to expect gold sales, DD&A expense and the effective tax rate to be within the original ranges.

The manner, timing, pricing and amount of any repurchases under the program will be subject to management's discretion and may be based upon market conditions and alternative opportunities for the use or investment of capital.

Subsequent to the end of the quarter, we formalized the outstanding security documents with Solaris required to fund the final $50 million of the total $200 million advance payment under the gold stream and royalty agreements for the Warintza Project in Ecuador, dated May 21, 2025.
We anticipate making the final payment after registration of the security documents is completed in the coming days.

Troilus further disclosed on September 28, 2026, that it is working to complete a broader financing package after receiving a commitment letter for US$850 million in debt financing to support project development.

At September 30, 2026, our contractual cash obligations comprised operating leases and the conditional $50.0 million Warintza funding, which we expect to make in the fourth quarter after the registration of security is completed.
Management’s conference call reviewing the third quarter results will be held on Thursday, November 5, 2026, at 12:00 pm Eastern Time (10:00 am Mountain Time).
The call will be webcast live and archived on the Company’s website for a limited time.
